history.overview: The Ritual Chamber is where Muramite Inquisitors bind Discord energy into ritual constructs.

timeline.name: Circle Carving
timeline.description: Dragorn slaves carved the initial ritual circles.

timeline.name: Anchor Installation
timeline.description: Discord pylons were installed to stabilize ritual energy.

timeline.name: Ritual Era
timeline.description: Inquisitors began conducting Discord rites to empower the Citadel.

timeline.name: Sacrifice Era
timeline.description: Dragorn captives were used as conduits for Discord rituals.
